st: Red Skull breaks HYDRA away from the Nazis and arms its troops with weapons powered by the Tesseract.
Steve and the Howling Commandos smash HYDRA's bases, Zola is captured, and Red Skull vanishes with the Tesseract.
In 2012, HYDRA agents guard Loki's scepter inside S.H.I.E.L.D., and Steve fools them with a whispered Hail HYDRA.
HYDRA reveals it grew in secret inside S.H.I.E.L.D. and launches Project Insight, until Steve's allies bring it down.
The Avengers raid HYDRA's last base in Sokovia, take back Loki's scepter, and capture Baron Strucker.
HYDRA agent Mitchell Carson tries to buy the Yellowjacket suit and slips away with a vial of its formula.
Zemo digs up HYDRA's 1991 mission that killed the Starks and kills its last frozen super soldiers in Siberia.
Bucky makes amends for the killings HYDRA forced on him, and Zemo kills Nagel, a scientist from its super soldier program.
The Falcon and the Winter Soldier

k: Wenwu's secret army, a thousand years old
Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
opp: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
st: Ten Rings fighters hold Tony Stark in an Afghan cave, until he escapes in armor and later breaks their grip on Gulmira.
Angry that an actor used the Mandarin's name, Ten Rings agents break Trevor Slattery out of prison.
Wenwu, its master for a thousand years, leads the Ten Rings against Ta Lo, and after his death Xialing takes command.
Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings

raft.k: Dreykov's secret school for Black Widows
st: In 1995, the Red Room pulls its sleeper agents out of Ohio and takes Natasha and Yelena away to be trained as Widows.
Wanda's spell shows Natasha her years in the Red Room, where Madame B trained her to kill and graduates were sterilized.
Natasha and Yelena find the hidden Red Room still enslaving Widows, free them, and bring it crashing down.

raft.k: A warrior empire ruled by the Supreme Intelligence
st: In 1995, the Kree wage war on the Skrulls through Yon-Rogg's Starforce and Ronan's fleet, until Carol turns on them.
The Kree Empire signs a peace treaty with Xandar, and its Accuser Ronan rejects it to destroy the planet himself.
Torn by civil war, the Kree follow Dar-Benn as she steals other worlds' resources, until Carol reignites Hala's sun.
Thanos's children hunt the Infinity Stones, attacking Strange in New York and Vision in Scotland and Wakanda.
Ebony Maw, Proxima Midnight, Corvus Glaive and Cull Obsidian all die at the heroes' hands.
A 2014 Black Order follows Thanos to the present, and its members die or turn to dust in the final battle.

raft.k: An alien army lent to Loki
st: The Other lends Loki a Chitauri army, which pours through a portal above New York.
The Chitauri collapse when Iron Man flies a nuclear missile into their mothership.
Chitauri forces fight for a 2014 Thanos at the Avengers Compound and turn to dust when Tony snaps.

raft.k: A golden, gene-perfect race ruled by Ayesha
st: The Sovereign hire the Guardians, then chase them with drone fleets after Rocket steals their batteries.
The Sovereign send Adam Warlock after Rocket for their maker, the High Evolutionary, and Ayesha dies on Counter-Earth.

raft.k: Advanced Idea Mechanics, Aldrich Killian's think tank
st: Killian's think tank turns wounded veterans into Extremis soldiers and blames their explosions on the Mandarin.
Tony and Rhodes stop A.I.M.'s plot against the President, Pepper kills Killian, and the Vice President is arrested.
Kaecilius's zealots steal a forbidden rite from Kamar-Taj and attack its Sanctums to bring Dormammu to Earth.
Strange bargains with Dormammu, who drags Kaecilius and his zealots into the Dark Dimension.

raft.k: The government's Department of Damage Control
st: After the Battle of New York, the new Department of Damage Control takes over the cleanup and drives Toomes's crew out.
Agent Cleary's Damage Control arrests and questions Peter Parker and his friends over Mysterio's death.
Damage Control hunts Kamala and Kamran across Jersey City, until Cleary takes Agent Deever off the case.
Damage Control has Trevor Slattery spy on the actor Simon Williams, then jails Trevor until Simon breaks him out.
Using the Hand as guards, Damage Control experiments on telepaths, until Spider-Man frees Jean Grey and it faces investigation.
Talokan's warriors kill a U.S. team hunting vibranium, then flood Wakanda's capital, and Queen Ramonda dies.
Shuri defeats Namor and spares him, and Talokan makes a truce with Wakanda.

raft.k: Monsters the Celestials sent to Earth
st: Sent to clear Earth of predators, the Deviants turn on humans, and the Eternals hunt them for thousands of years.
Kro and the last Deviants return, kill Ajak and Gilgamesh, and die at the Eternals' hands.
Gravik's rebel Skrulls plant impostors across Earth's governments to push humans toward war.
G'iah kills Gravik at New Skrullos, and Fury kills the impostor Raava, ending the rebels' plot.

raft.k: Djinn exiled from the Noor dimension
st: Najma's Clandestines try to force Kamala to use her bangle to tear open the Veil to their home dimension.
Two Clandestines die fighting the Red Daggers, and Najma gives her life to close the Veil.
Sidewinder's crew sells stolen classified items, and Sam captures Sidewinder after an ambush.

raft.k: Wilson Fisk's network of crime bosses, crooked cops and fixers
st: Fisk's alliance with Nobu, Madame Gao, Owlsley and the Ranskahovs carves up Hell's Kitchen with crooked cops on its payroll.
A dirty cop's testimony brings down the alliance, its corrupt officers are arrested, and Daredevil beats Fisk.
Freed by an FBI deal, Fisk runs his network from a hotel with crooked agents, until Matt beats him and he goes back to prison.
As the Kingpin, Fisk runs the Tracksuit Mafia and holds Eleanor Bishop in his debt, until Kate beats him on Christmas Eve.
Fisk's men and the Black Knife Cartel chase Maya into Oklahoma, but she and her family beat them at the powwow.
Elected mayor, Fisk turns City Hall into his machine, with Buck Cashman as his fixer and a task force of dirty cops.
Fisk's regime moves CIA weapons through Red Hook, until Karen's trial exposes it and Fisk takes a deal to leave New York.

compound.k: The world's spy agency
st: Howard Stark brings Peggy Carter in to lead his new agency, S.H.I.E.L.D.
In 1970, S.H.I.E.L.D. runs Camp Lehigh, where Steve and Tony slip in for the Tesseract and Pym Particles.
In 1989, Hank Pym resigns from S.H.I.E.L.D. when he learns it tried to copy his shrinking formula.
In 1995, agents Nick Fury and Phil Coulson help Carol Danvers against the Kree.
Agent Coulson approaches Tony Stark, and S.H.I.E.L.D. helps stop Obadiah Stane.
Nick Fury and Natasha Romanoff keep watch on Tony, and Coulson is sent to New Mexico.
S.H.I.E.L.D. seals off the crater where Mjolnir lands and seizes Jane Foster's research.
Coulson and Sitwell send Tony Stark to spoil the World Security Council's plan to recruit Emil Blonsky.
S.H.I.E.L.D. finds Steve Rogers in the Arctic ice and wakes him in New York, almost seventy years later.
Fury's S.H.I.E.L.D. assembles the Avengers against Loki, whose attack nearly brings down its helicarrier.
Agent Sitwell tracks down a couple robbing banks with a Chitauri gun, and S.H.I.E.L.D. hires them.
HYDRA is exposed inside S.H.I.E.L.D., and the agency collapses as Natasha dumps its secrets online.
Fury brings an old S.H.I.E.L.D. helicarrier to Sokovia to carry its people to safety.

compound.k: The Strategic Scientific Reserve, the Allies' secret science unit
st: The SSR's Project Rebirth turns Steve Rogers into a super soldier, and Colonel Phillips's unit takes the war to HYDRA.
Passed over at the SSR, Peggy recovers the Zodiac alone, and Howard Stark brings her in to lead S.H.I.E.L.D.

compound.k: Earth's Mightiest Heroes
st: Fury brings Tony, Steve, Thor, Bruce, Natasha and Clint together, and the Avengers stop Loki's invasion of New York.
The Avengers take HYDRA's last base and stop Tony's rogue AI Ultron in Sokovia, and Steve and Natasha train a new lineup.
Scott Lang breaks into the new Avengers Facility and holds his own against Sam Wilson.
The Sokovia Accords split the Avengers, and Steve breaks his jailed allies out of the Raft to go on the run.
Tony moves the Avengers upstate and offers Peter Parker a place on the team, which Peter turns down.
The scattered Avengers regroup against Thanos in New York, Scotland and Wakanda, but he wipes out half of all life.
At the Avengers Compound, the surviving Avengers meet Carol Danvers, who has come looking for Fury.
The Avengers take the Stones from the past, bring back the vanished and beat Thanos, then go their own ways after Tony's death.
President Ross asks Sam Wilson to rebuild the Avengers, and Sam invites Joaquin Torres to join.

compound.k: Valentina's misfit operatives, first called the Thunderbolts
st: Valentina's disposable agents team up as the Thunderbolts, save New York from the Void, and are unveiled as the New Avengers.

compound.k: The Time Variance Authority, keepers of the Sacred Timeline
st: The TVA arrests the 2012 Loki and prunes branching timelines, and its agents turn out to be variants with wiped memories.
TVA agents Mobius and Loki watch a Kang variant, Victor Timely, show off an invention in 1893.
As the TVA's Temporal Loom fails, Loki takes He Who Remains's place, and Hunter B-15 helps lead the agency.
Rogue TVA agent Paradox tries to erase Deadpool's universe, until Hunter B-15 takes him into custody.

compound.k: Space pirates who live by their own code
st: Kraglin recalls how Yondu's Ravagers raised a young Peter Quill, and how Yondu ruined Christmas aboard their ship.
The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special
Yondu's Ravagers hunt Peter Quill for the Orb, then fly against Ronan in the battle for Xandar.
Cast out by Stakar, Yondu's crew mutinies against him, and after he dies saving Peter, Ravager ships gather to honor him.
The Ravagers join the heroes in the final battle against Thanos's army.
Gamora, now a Ravager, helps the Guardians break into Orgocorp, then rejoins Stakar's crew.

compound.k: Xandar's interstellar police force
st: The Nova Corps lock up the Guardians, then fight beside them to save Xandar from Ronan.
Thor learns that Thanos decimated Xandar to take the Power Stone the Nova Corps guarded.

compound.n: The Masters of the Mystic Arts
compound.k: The sorcerers of Kamar-Taj who guard Earth from mystic threats
st: The Ancient One trains Strange at Kamar-Taj and dies fighting Kaecilius, and Mordo leaves the order.
Wong and Strange defend the New York Sanctum from Ebony Maw, and Strange later gives up the Time Stone and turns to dust.
The sorcerers open portals that bring heroes and armies to the final battle against Thanos.
Wong brings Shang-Chi to Kamar-Taj to study the Ten Rings with Bruce Banner and Carol Danvers.
Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
Wong, now Sorcerer Supreme, warns Strange against the spell to make the world forget Peter Parker.
The Scarlet Witch storms Kamar-Taj for America Chavez, many sorcerers die, and Sara gives her life to destroy the Darkhold.
Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
Wong hires Jen Walters to sue a magician who misuses the mystic arts.

compound.k: A band of outlaws who keep saving the galaxy
st: Peter Quill, Gamora, Drax, Rocket and Groot break out of a Nova prison together and stop Ronan as the Guardians.
The Guardians fight Quill's father, Ego, lose Yondu, and welcome Mantis and Nebula.
The Guardians pick up Thor, lose Gamora to Thanos, and most of them turn to dust in the Snap.
Rocket and Nebula help the Avengers, the restored Guardians join the final battle, and Thor flies off with them.
The Guardians fight beside Thor across the galaxy, then part ways with him.
Settled on Knowhere, the Guardians celebrate Christmas, and Mantis and Drax bring Kevin Bacon as Quill's gift.
The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special
The Guardians save Rocket from the High Evolutionary, then go their own ways as Rocket leads a new team.

compound.k: Immortal beings sent to Earth by a Celestial
st: Sent to Earth by Arishem in 5000 BC, the Eternals fight the Deviants for thousands of years, then go their own ways.
The Eternals reunite to stop the Emergence, Ikaris betrays them, and Arishem takes Sersi, Kingo and Phastos to be judged.

compound.k: Earth-828's first family of heroes
st: On Earth-828, the Fantastic Four fly into space to face Galactus, who demands Reed and Sue's unborn son.
Back home, the team rallies the world and sends Galactus away through a giant portal.

compound.k: New York's street-level heroes, teamed up
st: Matt, Jessica, Luke and Danny team up against the Hand and bury its leaders under Midland Circle, and Matt goes missing.

compound.k: A government agency that watches for alien and cosmic threats
st: Acting Director Hayward secretly rebuilds Vision as a weapon, until Monica Rambeau exposes him and he is arrested.

compound.k: Nick Fury's space station
st: Fury returns to Earth from S.A.B.E.R., then leaves with Varra to help broker peace with the Kree.
From S.A.B.E.R., Fury helps Carol, Monica and Kamala stop Dar-Benn.

compound.k: Wakanda's all-female royal guard
st: In 1260 BC, Akeya of the Dora Milaje sends Noni after a rogue agent, then invites her back.
The Dora Milaje guard T'Challa in Vienna, and Ayo warns Natasha off.
Okoye's Dora Milaje serve the throne even under Killmonger, then fight his forces when T'Challa returns.
The Dora Milaje fight Thanos's army in Wakanda.
The Dora Milaje fight in the final battle against Thanos.
Ayo's Dora Milaje come for Zemo, beat John Walker in a fight, and later take Zemo to the Raft.
The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
Ramonda strips Okoye of her title, and Ayo leads the Dora Milaje against Namor's warriors.

compound.k: Wakanda's mountain tribe, led by M'Baku
st: M'Baku's Jabari, who reject the throne, shelter the wounded T'Challa and ride into battle against Killmonger.
M'Baku leads the Jabari against Thanos's army in Wakanda.
Wakanda's people shelter in the Jabari mountains after Namor's attack, and M'Baku fights beside Shuri.

compound.k: Wakanda's War Dogs, its spies in the outside world
st: From Bronze Age Crete to Troy and K'un-Lun, Hatut Zaraze agents track down rogue agents and stolen vibranium for Wakanda.
War Dogs spy for Wakanda across the world, and Killmonger plans to ship them weapons, until T'Challa stops him.

compound.k: The body resettling people displaced after the Blip
st: The GRC plans to relocate people displaced after the Blip, until Sam urges it to help them instead.
The Falcon and the Winter Soldier

compound.k: The witches who walk the Witches' Road with Agatha
st: Agatha gathers Teen, Lilia, Jen, Alice and Sharon Davis into a coven to walk the Witches' Road.
Sharon, Alice and Lilia die on the Road, Jen leaves with her powers back, and Teen is revealed as Billy.

compound.k: Karachi vigilantes sworn to stop the Clandestines
st: Waleed's Red Daggers train Kamala in Karachi, until Najma kills Waleed, and Kareem later takes in Kamran.

compound.k: Jentorra's freedom fighters
st: Jentorra's rebels hide from Kang in the Quantum Realm, and Cassie leads them in an uprising that breaks his rule.

compound.k: Shape-shifting refugees who lost their homeworld
st: Hunted by the Kree, Talos's Skrull refugees hide in Mar-Vell's lab, until Carol helps them escape to find a new home.
Talos and Soren pose as Fury and Maria Hill on Earth while Fury works in space.
Gravik turns many Skrulls on Earth against humans, and after he dies the President orders all Skrulls hunted.
Dar-Benn strips the air from the Skrull colony on Tarnax, and Carol and her allies evacuate it.

add_steps: Maya's father William runs a Tracksuit Mafia crew for Fisk, until the Ronin attacks the gang and kills him.
fixes.why: Echo's first episode shows the gang under William Lopez and the Ronin attack. It happens years before Hawkeye, so insert before the Hawkeye step.

add_steps: Once Fisk takes a deal to leave New York, the Task Force is disbanded and its officers are arrested.
fixes.why: The file ends with the Task Force still Active, but the season 2 finale disbands it and arrests its officers. Append as the last step.

add_steps: In 2018, Yelena and Sonya are helping freed Widows when they visit another former Widow, Ana.
fixes.why: Hawkeye's fifth episode opens with Yelena and Sonya helping deprogrammed Widows before the Blip. Append after the Black Widow steps.
